doc: Hunters drawn on Meshy's own skeleton and clips (scripts/heroes/warden_native.gd, docs/art/wardens/MESHY_NATIVE.md), keyed by art name. meshy_native: the switch (off = the contract model as before). file: art/wardens/<art>/<art>_meshy.glb. scale: Meshy's 1.9 m model onto the contract model's head height. clips: game state -> Meshy clip. walk_mps/run_mps/crouch_mps: m/s ground speed each loop plays at rate 1; run_from: m/s where the walk hands to the run; attack_rate, jump_rate: play rate of those one-shots. hand: Meshy's bone the weapon's aim node rides. anchors: anchor empty -> the Meshy bone it rides.
